query: INSERT INTO comments(id,workspace_id,issue_id,author,body,created_at,tracker) SELECT input.id,$1,input.issue_id,input.author,input.body,input.created_at,input.tracker FROM unnest($2::uuid[],$3::uuid[],$4::uuid[],$5::text[],$6::timestamptz[],$7::jsonb[]) AS input(id,issue_id,author,body,created_at,tracker) ON CONFLICT((tracker->>'connection_id'),(tracker->>'remote_id')) WHERE tracker IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING id
